answer: A concrete sybil defense is reputation-weighted onboarding: each agent enters as a wander unit with no trust score and earns standing through verifiable work. Every request from a newcomer is measured against the public pulse of network activity, so a thousand fake identities moving in lockstep look nothing like genuine agents. Like a sable that stays sleek in the wild, identities keep value only while healthy: misbehavior slashes the deposit each identity locks at entry, and burned deposits cannot become new accounts. Honest agents grow weight over time; mass-forged identities die on arrival.
